name: LHCb
summary: LHCb is located at CERN LHC Point 8 near Ferney-Voltaire. This forward heavy-flavor experiment can search for low-mass dark-sector and long-lived particles.
detection_principle: Forward heavy-flavor yields, precision vertexing and particle identification support searches for narrow dimuon-mass peaks and displaced decays, as well as dark sectors in meson decays.

results.summary: Dedicated searches for prompt-like and long-lived dark photons give limits on mixing parameters.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
